component.name: ipabazooka
component.summary: Install apps on your iPhone or iPad

description.p: ipabazooka is a beginner-friendly Sideloadly alternative. It signs an app file (.ipa) with your own free Apple ID and installs it on your iPhone or iPad over USB. No jailbreak or paid developer account is needed.

ul.li: Drag and drop an .ipa to see what's inside before installing
Built-in help that explains sideloading step by step
Plain-English error messages that say what to do next
Phone tools: list and remove installed apps, Developer Mode

description.p: First Linux release: .deb, .rpm, Arch package, AppImage and a portable archive.
